summary: Open-source, pay-as-you-go alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs, with an MCP server and skills so AI agents can do keyword and rank research.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: OpenSEO is an open-source SEO tool for keyword research, rank tracking, competitor insights, backlinks, site audits and AI visibility. It exposes an MCP server so agents like Claude Code, OpenClaw, Hermes and ChatGPT can use your SEO data, and ships agent skills for common SEO tasks. Data comes from DataForSEO, which you pay for directly.
sixtySeconds.problem: Semrush and Ahrefs are expensive subscriptions with more than most people need. OpenSEO gives focused workflows and you pay only for the data you use.
whoFor: Founders and marketers doing their own SEO
People who want SEO data inside their AI agent
Developers who want to customize an SEO tool
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for no subscription when self-hosting, MCP and agent skills, a simple UI and code you can fork.
requirements: A DataForSEO API key (or a treg account)
EveryApp on Cloudflare, Docker, or your own Cloudflare account to self-host

overview: Try the hosted version at openseo.so; a hosted subscription is $10/month. The hosted service adds 28% to each DataForSEO request.

The recommended self-hosted route is EveryApp, which runs in your Cloudflare account. Install its CLI, set up a domain and install OpenSEO. Docker and standalone Cloudflare setups are documented in the repo.
Self-hosted accounts use email and password; the first visitor becomes admin. It is MIT licensed.
